en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river bend with a long multi‑arch stone bridge carrying a tram line and roadway. On the near riverbank there is a rail yard with several tracks, warehouses, and industrial buildings with tall smokestacks and a large gas holder. On the far heights stand dense residential quarters and, to the right, a tall spired church dominating the skyline. The scene is framed by trees and shrubs in the foreground and steep rocky slopes on the right. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
